name: engram
description: Local engineering memory, context compilation, and Change Contract guard for AI coding agents.

engram.binaryPath.description: Explicit absolute path to the engram executable. If set, Engram will only use this binary and will not fall back to other paths if invalid.

engram.timeoutMs.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds for engram CLI commands.

languageModelTools.name: engram_get_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve relevant project constraints, architecture rules, and token-budgeted context before implementing features or fixing non-trivial bugs. Call automatically when starting implementation tasks.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compile token-optimized project context and engineering memory before editing.

task.description: The coding task goal, intent, or keywords

languageModelTools.name: engram_preflight
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Pre-flight handshake: inspect blast radius, review governing decisions, and lock a Change Contract before high-risk or architectural modifications.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Lock a Change Contract and inspect blast radius before modifying code.

task.description: The coding task goal or intent

languageModelTools.name: engram_postflight
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Post-flight compliance audit: verify changes against Change Contract boundary rules and detect violations after completing modifications.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Verify changes against Change Contract boundary rules and detect violations.

contract_id.description: Active Change Contract ID to validate against

strict.description: Fail if unexpected files are modified

staged.description: Validate git staged index instead of entire working tree

languageModelTools.name: engram_get_impact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze reverse dependencies and blast radius for a file or symbol. Call automatically before modifying shared services, public interfaces, state, or routing.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Fast 1-hop reverse dependency and blast radius impact query.

target.description: Symbol name or relative file path

languageModelTools.name: engram_inspect_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Multi-hop blast radius impact query, Change Contract authorization check, and scoped memory lookup for a target symbol or file.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Multi-hop blast radius impact query and scoped memory lookup.

target.description: Target symbol or file path to inspect

languageModelTools.name: engram_why
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explain architectural rationale, governing decisions, and commit history for a symbol or file. Call automatically when investigating why code was structured this way or why tests fail.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Architectural archaeology: explain rationale and governing decisions.

target.description: Symbol name or relative file path

languageModelTools.name: engram_get_cochanges
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve historical Git co-change coupling signals and statistics for a given file.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Retrieve historical Git co-change coupling signals and statistics.

languageModelTools.name: engram_get_memory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve durable architectural decisions, policies, and institutional engineering memories.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Retrieve durable architectural decisions, policies, and institutional engineering memories.

languageModelTools.name: engram_record_decision
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Propose an architectural decision into engineering memory (marked PROVISIONAL until human ratification).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Propose an architectural decision into engineering memory.

title.description: Short title of the architectural decision

statement.description: The exact decision policy or architectural invariant

modules.description: Architectural modules governed by this decision

files.description: Specific files governed by this decision

accepted_by.description: Agent or engineer proposing this decision

languageModelTools.name: engram_check_constitution
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate architectural constitution rules and boundary isolation policies against changed files.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Evaluate architectural constitution rules against modified files.

files.description: Specific file paths to check (defaults to git diff)

languageModelTools.name: engram_get_ecosystem
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Detect workspace ecosystem, primary language, manifest dependencies, build tools, and framework rules.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Detect workspace ecosystem, language, dependencies, and build tools.

languageModelTools.name: engram_doctor
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run diagnostic health checks on memory storage, index integrity, and append-only cryptographic chains.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run diagnostic health checks on memory storage and index integrity.

languageModelTools.name: engram_recover
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Formulate structured, non-destructive recovery recipe for contract violations and check exhaustion gate.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Formulate structured recovery recipe for contract violations.

contract_id.description: Change Contract ID to formulate recovery plan for

languageModelTools.name: engram_drift
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze architectural decision drift, boundary erosion, and scoped staleness across commits.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Analyze architectural decision drift and staleness across commits.

since.description: Analyze commits since this commit hash

languageModelTools.name: engram_ratify_decision
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explicitly ratify an architectural decision with human reviewer authorization and provenance tracking.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Explicitly ratify an architectural decision with reviewer authorization.

commit.description: Git commit SHA being ratified (defaults to HEAD)
